text:
Ava: quick heads-up — hitting 401s on the hello quickstart during first deploy. saw different env var names in examples.
Ben: which examples exactly?
Ava: quickstart/hello.md uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN in the bash snippet, but SDK examples expect REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Carmen: ugh, that would do it. we've had a couple support pings that match this.
Darren: can we patch both the bash and SDK snippets in one PR? also add a tiny smoke test so CI will catch regressions.
Ava: proposed fixes: update bash to `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...`, update py/ts snippets to reference REDWOOD_API_KEY, add a one-line troubleshooting note about 401s.
Ben: TS change example: `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });` — i tested locally and it works.
Carmen: i'll open a docs PR and include an examples/hello/auth_smoke.sh that checks `curl` to the /v1/whoami endpoint and exits 1 on 401.
Ava: add a quick sentence in troubleshooting: "If you see 401 immediately after deploy, verify your env var name and token format."
Darren: when you open the PR, add @eng for a runtime snippet sanity check. add me and @Ava as reviewers.
Carmen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518 — corrected snippets + smoke script + docs-ci step.
Ben: LGTM pending smoke CI. verified examples run locally with REDWOOD_API_KEY.
deploy-bot: docs build started for PR 518 (job: docs-ci)
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 518 (job: docs-ci, duration: 2m 22s). smoke script passed. :white_check_mark:
Darren: merging into next docs patch release notes under "Quickstart fixes".
Ava: can we also grep other quickstarts for REDWOOD_API_TOKEN vs REDWOOD_API_KEY? maybe add a small script to flag mismatches.
Carmen: will add follow-up issue and run a grep across `docs/quickstart` to find any remaining mismatches. assigning to docs squad.
Ava: great — thanks all. closing thread after merge.
